label: Concept Interior
description: Cockpit and interior design language — visible through glass in exterior shots or carrying a dedicated interior frame.

items.name: wraparound-display
items.text: a wraparound cockpit display, one seamless curved screen flowing from door to door beneath the windshield

items.name: carbon-monocoque-tub
items.text: an exposed carbon monocoque tub, the structural weave left visible along the sills and tunnel

items.name: shell-seats-harness
items.text: sculpted shell seats trimmed in perforated Alcantara, six-point harnesses routed through dedicated slots

items.name: yoke-steering
items.text: a flat-top yoke steering wheel dense with anodized rotary controls and a center-marked rim

items.name: ambient-light-blade
items.text: a single ambient light blade running the full width of the dash, its color echoing the exterior accents

items.name: floating-center-console
items.text: a floating center console bridged in brushed aluminum, crowned by a crystalline gear selector

items.name: minimalist-lounge
items.text: a minimalist lounge cabin, pale wool and open-pore wood where the dials would be

items.name: camera-mirror-screens
items.text: slim door-mounted screens replacing the mirrors, camera feeds glowing at each A-pillar
